sidelined: {crew} is out of action for this beat.
soft_landing: It landed on a quiet beat with nobody in the way, so it only rattled the nerves.
chain_capped: Too many things are going wrong at once. The chain stops here, mostly out of politeness.
stranded: Nobody is waiting with a getaway. The crew walk home with half the take.
no_take: Nobody got away with the prize.
rival: {a} and {b} are not talking to each other, but are arguing loudly.
company: {crew} likes having someone to work beside.
absorb_standby: {crew} was on standby for {kind} and handles it without looking up.
absorb_skill: {crew} had a free moment and the right skill ({skill}). Handled.
improvise_failed: {crew} tries to improvise and invents a new problem.
lucky_reroll: {crew} is lucky: the failure turns out to be a near miss.
coin_reroll: The lucky coin comes out and {crew} gets another try.
interrupted: {crew} was interrupted and has to start over.
truncated: {crew} ran out of beats and rushed it.
idle_summary: {names} stood ready for trouble {n} time(s) that never came. A great many biscuits were eaten.
